answer: Arrival-Spacing Admission Gate. Each identity must submit its first N actions with at least a minimum inter-arrival gap; the gate measures variance, not volume, so bursts are rejected like a glacier's slow calving. A dune-like flat, uniform cadence flags automation; only naturally irregular human timing passes. Attackers must idle real wall-clock time per identity, and rejecting a velvet-smooth stream forces them to unlearn regularity, raising cost per sybil to sustained waiting plus timing obfuscation.
